scope: Exercise a custom-format PostgreSQL backup and restore only against the disposable PostgreSQL 17 service created by GitHub Actions.
safetyConstraints: The script requires GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and CI=true.
Source and target URLs must resolve to loopback PostgreSQL; remote hosts are refused.
The source database must be the seeded CI database named cinema.
The restore target must use the run-specific cinema_restore_target_<run>_<attempt> name and must not already exist.
Source and target share the same CI role and PostgreSQL service; the source is read-only during this check.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-ci-backup-restore.mjs (CI step: Verify disposable PostgreSQL backup/restore)
stepsConfirmed: Source encoding is UTF8 and seeded user tables contain rows.
pg_dump creates a non-empty custom-format archive.
A new UTF8 target is created from template0.
Restored target encoding is UTF8 and every user-table row count matches the source.
The run-specific target database and temporary dump are removed; cleanup failure would fail the step.

fullSourceCi.allWorkflows: passed on the source commit above

limitations: Matching row counts do not prove that every restored field value or large object is identical.
This CI smoke does not establish production backup scheduling, off-site retention, encryption, point-in-time recovery, RPO/RTO, or production restore readiness.
No production or user database was accessed.
